importantNotes: 'God is love' (4:8) — one of the most profound statements about God's nature.
'If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us' (1:9) — assurance of forgiveness.
The letter addresses Gnostic-type heresy that denied Jesus came in the flesh.
'These things I have written to you so that you may know you have eternal life' (5:13).
John wrote this letter as an elderly man — tradition says he was the last surviving apostle.

chapters.1: The Word of Life revealed; God is light — walk in the light; confess sin for forgiveness.
chapters.2: Jesus our advocate; keep His commands; do not love the world; watch for antichrists.
chapters.3: Children of God — love one another in deed and truth, not just in words.
chapters.4: Test the spirits; God is love; perfect love drives out fear; we love because He first loved us.
chapters.5: Faith overcomes the world; the testimony about the Son; assurance of eternal life.
